about: Every setting AppCollection reads. One list for the check (scripts/settings.mjs), the copy to Vercel (scripts/push-settings-to-vercel.mjs) and .env.example (npm run settings:example). hosted: 'required' = must be set on Vercel, 'forbidden' = must not exist there, 'optional' otherwise. Values live in Infisical, project appcollection, environment prod; never here.

settings.name: STATUS_GITHUB_TOKEN
settings.description: Fine-grained read-only GitHub token (Contents, Pull requests, Deployments) for the sjoerdvanloon repositories. Without it /status and the weekly report see public repositories only
